faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Velar D300 use?
faqLeft.a: It uses the 3.0-litre inline-six Ingenium AJ300D diesel engine. This engine has been fitted to the Velar D300 since its launch in 2017.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Velar D300 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £3,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Velar D300?
faqLeft.a: Your Velar D300 has the AJ300D engine code. Enter your registration on this page and we can confirm the exact year and specification for your vehicle.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ300D Velar D300 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, injector seals, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Velar D300 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Velar D300 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Velar D300 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Velar D300 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
